_comment: Golden cases for the scope-by-evidence arm (item 6.0a, ADR-030). This file is a CONTRACT, not a
fixture: two languages implement parts of the same functions and nothing else forces them to agree.
Go     (authoritative, runs at write time and on the hit path): gateway/internal/reuse/scope.go
Python (builds the document metadata, calibrates tau_P):        rag/src/rag/docmeta.py,
experiments/scripts/scope_calibrate.py
Why the pin exists. The Python side decides which words of a product are 'bound' to it (docmeta, one
run). The Go side tests an answer against those words (every miss). If the two tokenizers differ,
a bound word is never found, every policy answer looks neutral, and an answer that names its product
is stored for all products. Nothing errors, and a trap query comes back across products.
The projection has the same risk: tau_P is calibrated in Python on projected vectors, and the gateway
serves with its own projection. A difference shifts every shared hit by a constant.
tokenize: ASCII letters and digits make tokens; the case of an ASCII letter is folded; every other
character (punctuation, spaces, accents, letters of other scripts) separates tokens; a token of
fewer than 2 characters is dropped. The result is a set, listed here sorted.
scope:    the decision for one POLICY answer. 'shared' only when the lane is POLICY, the product has a
title vector, the policy document has metadata, both documents have the same non-empty category,
and no token of the answer is one of the product's bound words. Otherwise 'product'.
project:  v' = normalise(v - (v . t^) t^), with t^ = t / |t|. The result is null when t is missing or
empty, when |v| is 0, or when |v'| <= 1e-6 * |v|. 'tol' is the largest allowed difference per
component (the gateway works in float32).
Adding a case is cheap and is the right response to any question about these rules. Changing an
existing 'out' changes the rule and needs a numbered decision.

tokenize.name: a unit stays with its number

scope.name: a neutral policy answer is shared
scope.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

scope.name: a bound word makes it product scope
scope.answer: Yes, the Bravia can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

scope.name: a bound word inside a hyphenated model name is found
scope.answer: The KDL-52XBR4 can be sent back within 30 days.

scope.name: a bound word is matched as a whole token, not as a part of one
scope.answer: Please clear the cache before you send it back.

scope.name: another category stays product scope
scope.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

scope.name: a missing title vector stays product scope
scope.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

scope.name: a missing policy document stays product scope
scope.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

scope.name: an empty policy category is never shared
scope.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

scope.name: the SPEC lane is never shared
scope.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

scope.name: the MIXED lane is never shared
scope.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

project.name: renormalises a v that is not unit
renormalises a t that is not unit
v along t has nothing left
a zero v has nothing to project
